thread:
mira: Quick heads-up 1 noticed the KV-prefix dashboard example in console/kvcache.md is still using the old `kv_prefix: user:` key, but runtime now expects `kv_prefixes: ["user:"]` (array). Live preview errors.
hugo: Ah yeah that changed in the v2 presets schema. We should update docs and show both legacy and new shapes in the migration section.
sam: Can you add a tiny snippet showing how to migrate with a jq transform? Ops asked for a safe non-destructive mapping.
mira: Suggest `jq 'if has("kv_prefix") then .kv_prefixes = [ .kv_prefix ] | del(.kv_prefix) else . end'` as a starting point. Add a note about null/empty cases.
hugo: Also the tracing-hook page references `trace_hex` in examples but the Console preset sample still documents `trace_id`. We should add a short cross-reference bullet and a migration anchor `#tracekey-mapping`.
sam: I'll prepare a PR that: 1) fixes kvcache example frontmatter (`presets: true`), 2) adds jq migration snippet, 3) adds Python + Node one-liners showing how to attach `trace_hex` using the SDK helper, 4) adds a changelog entry.
ci-bot: lint/links-checker started for PR #10177 by sam
infra-bot: FYI we can add an internal redirect from `/presets/kv_prefix` -> `/presets/kv_prefixes` but infra needs a ticket.
hugo: Good call. Add infra ticket INF-2791 to the PR description.
mira: For the SDK snippets, keep them minimal: Python: ```python
from redwood import tracing
tracing.attach_trace_hex(request, "0xabc123")
``` Node: ```js
await redwood.tracing.attachTraceHex(req, "0xabc123")
``` Add a one-line comment about removing the `0x` prefix if needed.
sam: Added both snippets, included `#tracekey-mapping` anchor, and included the jq safe-transform with a short explanation for empty/missing keys. Also added alt text to the KV cache diagram: "Heatmap showing cache hit rate by prefix over the last 24 hours".
ci-bot: example-sniffer job failed: missing `presets: true` frontmatter on console/kvcache.md (line 3)
sam: Fixed frontmatter, re-pushed.
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #10177
infra-bot: INF-2791 created and linked 1 will follow-up with wildcard redirect rule.
hugo: Quick tech review done. Small nit: in the Python snippet prefer `tracing.attach_trace_hex_from_request(request)` to match SDK naming. Can you rename?
sam: Renamed function to match SDK. Pushed.
ci-bot: Toast: PR #10177 merged by sam 44aa
mira: Thanks! Filed follow-up issue to add a Rust example and a migration smoke test to ensure dashboards render after presets transforms: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4150
hugo: I'll grab the Rust example next sprint. Closing thread.
